name: @avatark/world-memory-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 11's World Memory / Entity Memory derivation: deterministic significance filtering, structured causal provenance, entity-memory derivation, memory-influenced behavior hints, emergent-encounter resolution, encounter history tracking, return recognition, a retention/compaction reference policy, and reference in-memory repositories. Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/significance.test.ts src/retentionPolicy.test.ts src/worldEventDerivation.test.ts src/entityMemoryDerivation.test.ts src/memoryInfluence.test.ts src/emergentEncounters.test.ts src/encounterHistory.test.ts src/returnRecognition.test.ts src/inMemoryRepositories.test.ts src/replayIdempotency.test.ts src/livingForestMemoryPortability.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
